agentPolicyId.description: The ID of the agent policy associated with the private location.

id.description: The unique identifier of the private location.

isInvalid.description: Indicates whether the location is invalid. If `true`, the location is invalid, which means the agent policy associated with the location is deleted.

label.description: A label for the private location.

namespace.description: The namespace of the location, which is the same as the namespace of the agent policy associated with the location.

spaces.description: The space IDs where the private location is available.

tags.description: An array of tags to categorize the private location.
